steps.label: Hardware-efficient
steps.sub: Cheap native gates -- minimizes hardware error, but can struggle to express the true ground state

steps.label: Chemistry-inspired (UCC)
steps.sub: Built from physical electron-excitation insight -- fewer parameters, but deeper circuits

steps.label: The hard fact
steps.sub: If the true ground state isn't expressible by your ansatz, no optimization will find it

steps.label: More parameters
steps.sub: Can represent a wider range of states, including a closer approach to the true ground state

steps.label: Harder to train
steps.sub: A higher-dimensional landscape, and more risk of barren plateaus

steps.label: Not a solved recipe
steps.sub: Choosing well, for a specific problem and hardware, is active research
